## What
- [ ] Summary of changes
- [ ] Files changed (scoped to task requirements)
- [ ] Configuration changes (if any)

## Why
- [ ] Acceptance criteria mapped to changes
- [ ] Problem being solved
- [ ] Business value

## Checks
- [ ] Lint/build/test pass
- [ ] Policies: Security / Privacy / A11y / Observability
- [ ] Collector configuration validates
- [ ] Canary tests pass

## Testing
- [ ] Smoke tests run successfully
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] Rollback plan documented

## Observability Impact
- [ ] No impact on existing dashboards
- [ ] New metrics/logs documented
- [ ] Alert thresholds reviewed
